country.title: Country code
country.description: ISO country used by the Eufy cloud (e.g. US, DE, IL).

trustedDeviceName.title: Trusted device name
trustedDeviceName.description: Name shown in the Eufy app for this connection.

pollingIntervalMinutes.title: Cloud polling interval (minutes)
pollingIntervalMinutes.description: How often to refresh the device list after cameras are found. When none are found yet, the plugin retries every 60 seconds.

mfaCode.title: MFA / 2FA code
mfaCode.description: Only needed when Eufy asks for a one-time login code. Clear after a successful connect.

captchaId.title: Captcha id
captchaId.description: From Homebridge logs when a captcha is requested.

ffmpegPath.title: Custom ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Optional. Defaults to the bundled ffmpeg-for-homebridge binary, then system ffmpeg.
